close_reason: Landed in 8d12c8e. The three pipeline_* bench targets are removed from the criterion_group! list and the file. Module doc comment now explains the two-mode design (parse-only / convert-only with parse hoisted out of inner loop) and explicitly notes that pipeline was dropped because parse_* + convert_* gives strictly more diagnostic information.
description:
Path: crate-jmap-mime/benches/mime_pipeline.rs has 9 bench targets across 3 sizes × 3 modes: parse_only, convert_only, and pipeline (= parse + convert). Pipeline is the sum of parse + convert; it adds no signal that the other two do not provide, but it doubles the bench wall-clock cost and the noise in regression analysis.

Expected impact at scale: pipeline_large_deep_multipart alone parses + converts a ~1 MB message in the inner loop. With criterion's default sample count this is several seconds per bench, ~30s total for the three pipeline_* benches. Removing them cuts 'cargo bench -p jmap-mime' wall-clock by ~33% without losing any diagnostic information.

When a regression appears, the operator needs to know whether it lives in mime-tree::parse or in jmap-mime::message_to_jmap_body. parse_* and convert_* answer exactly that question. pipeline_* answers a question (how long does the combined operation take?) that is mechanically derivable from the other two.

Fix: delete bench_pipeline_small, bench_pipeline_medium, bench_pipeline_large and drop them from the criterion_group! list. Update the file-level doc comment to drop the 'pipeline' mode description.

Counterargument someone might make: pipeline_* catches cache / branch-predictor interaction effects that parse_* + convert_* miss. Reply: that is theoretically true but in practice the parse output is small enough (~tens of KB even for the 1 MB fixture once decoded structurally) that L2 effects dominate identically in both modes. If a real regression were ever traced to that interaction, the right response is a dedicated bench with a clearly stated cache-effect hypothesis, not three pipeline benches running by default.
title: Bench: pipeline_* benches are redundant with parse_* + convert_*
